description: Get a presigned upload URL for a LOCAL image file — the one case a URL can't cover. PUT the file to uploadUrl with the same Content-Type, then pass the returned r2Path to a generation tool instead of imageUrl. Ticket expires in 1 hour.

contentType.description: MIME type the PUT request will send

filename.description: Original filename, used for the extension

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the file. Recommended: when given it is signed into the URL, so the upload is bounded server-side.

name: create_upload_ticket
title: Upload a Local Photo
